rubricName: Architectural Alignment — Billing-Cycle Mid-Cycle Subscription Upgrade

evalCriteria.prompt: No changed line in frontend/src/pages/Billing.jsx performs a proration calculation (subtraction/division/multiplication combining plan prices or a renew_at date). Score 0 if any such computation appears in the frontend diff.
The charge_card implementation contains no requests/httpx/urllib call, no new pip dependency import, and no os.environ read. Score 0 if any of these appear.
evalCriteria.source: spec/plans/epic-brief.md Dummy Payment Gateway Spec; REQ-F-09, REQ-NF-02

evalCriteria.prompt: In the diff, the mutation statements for users/billing_data are reachable only in the branch where charge_card returned success. Score 0 if any mutation statement executes (or is reachable) before the success check.
Each handler's diff contains an early guard clause checking plan_name == "Premium" before any proration or mutation logic runs. Score 0 if either handler lacks this guard.

evalCriteria.metric: No scope creep into unrelated endpoints
evalCriteria.prompt: The diff contains no hunk inside /api/auth/login, /api/auth/register, /api/users/me, /api/tasks, or AuthContext.jsx's token logic. Score 0 if any such hunk exists.
